issue: Does 18 U.S.C. § 666(a)(2) criminalize only quid pro quo bribery, or also gratuities given to local officials without any reciprocal exchange?

sides.position: Section 666(a)(2) reaches only quid pro quo bribery; gratuities without reciprocity are not criminalized.
cases: United States v. Hamilton, No. 21-11157 (5th Cir. 2023)

sides.position: Section 666(a)(2) also criminalizes gratuities to local officials even in the absence of reciprocity (a quid without a quo).

this_court: Section 666(a)(2) reaches only quid pro quo bribery (the panel's holding, which the dissent from denial of rehearing en banc criticizes).
quote: In doing so, the panel noted that it was putting our circuit on the short end of a “lopsided split” on this issue—joining the First Circuit against the Second, Sixth, Seventh, Eighth, and Eleventh Circuits.
cite: United States v. Hamilton, No. 21-11157 (5th Cir. 2023)
